page_records.catalogue_description: 318–320-page publication presenting 154 original alphabets by artists from 30 countries. Each artist was asked to design all 26 Latin letters on a single page. A page-level artist index with page numbers is maintained in docs/lettering/style-library/street-fonts-artist-index.v1.json. Contributions span multiple media.
page_records.creator: 154 graffiti artists; curated by Claudia Walde (MadC)
page_records.next_action: Request a reading-room appointment at Martha Cooper Library / URBAN NATION Berlin (catalogue lists the German edition as available Präsenzbestand; no interlibrary loan). Confirm title availability and photography/reproduction rules before travel. At inspection, work through the 154-entry index, record medium/technique and prioritize hand-drawn, marker and sketch alphabets; do not create glyph observations from catalogue descriptions.
page_records.reason: This is unusually well matched to the research goal: standardized complete A–Z pages allow direct cross-writer comparison of the same letters, including repeated A/B/E/R/S/T forms. It is an authored alphabet collection, not necessarily raw spontaneous blackbook writing; each contribution's medium and construction method must be recorded.
